product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - AS/NZS 3112 (Australia/New Zealand) to IEC 60320 C13 H05VV-F 3G 0.75 mm Black 6ft
product.description: This AC power cord is designed to connect a computer or other device to an electrical outlet that conforms to the Australian/New Zealand standard. The Australian/New Zealand standard is used in Australia, New Zealand, Fiji, Tonga, Solomon Islands, and Papua New Guinea. It features a grounded AS/NZS 3112 plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C13 receptacle on the other end.
